header.title: How to Defrost a Deep Freezer
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to safely and effectively defrost a deep freezer, minimizing food spoilage and preventing water damage.

steps.description: This step involves unplugging the deep freezer and removing its contents and shelves to prepare it for defrosting.
actions: Unplug the deep freezer
Remove all contents from the deep freezer
Place items inside a cooler with ice packs
Remove shelves from the deep freezer

steps.description: This step involves preparing the deep freezer for defrosting by lining it with towels and baking sheets to contain melting ice and water.
actions: Take several towels and fold them in half.
Place one of the folded towels in the bottom of the deep freezer.
Use as many towels as you need in order to cover the bottom.
Fold the towels more than one time, if needed, depending on the size of the freezer.
Put the aluminum baking sheets on top of the folded towels.
Place two or more baking sheets side by side, depending on the size of the deep freezer.

steps.description: Protect the floor from water seepage by placing a plastic sheet and towels under the deep freezer.
actions: Cut a large garbage bag along its seam.
Place the plastic under the deep freezer.
Remove the contents from the freezer.
Place towels on top of the plastic sheet.

steps.description: Remove ice from the freezer walls by scraping and allowing it to fall into pans, then wipe down the interior.
actions: Allow the deep freezer to defrost with the power off and contents removed.
Wait for ice to drop from the walls or loosen.
Dump the aluminum pans when ice falls freely.
Scrape off the sides of the deep freezer with a plastic spatula.
Allow loose ice to fall into the pan.
Continue scraping until all ice is removed.
Wipe down the inside of the deep freezer.
Remove the bag.
Plug the deep freezer in.
Load the freezer back up with its contents.
